items.t: **The rig:** Ableton Live 10 Standard 10.1.43 · NI VST2 in the 64-bit folder · Massive · Kontakt 6/7/8 · Reaktor 6 · MPK Mini mapped. Massive factory library installed (Papi, 9/11).

**The pass:** one background agent checking Cymatics, ADSR, Ghosthack, Function Loops, Black Octopus, Plugin Boutique, KVR, Reddit threads and producer giveaways; confirms live, Massive not X, count, free versus email, reputation.
**Install:** .nmsv files go in Documents\Native Instruments\Massive\Sounds (or a user folder set in Massive's browser), then rescan.
**1 · Cymatics — Massive Gems Vol. 1 + 2** · 40 presets · free with email · general bass, lead, pad · the most-cited source, vault live in 2026 · cymatics.fm/pages/free-download-vault
**2 · Sample Magic — Free Massive Pack** · 96 · free, likely email · trap, dubstep, techno, house · curated from a paid catalogue; the largest reputable single bank

**3 · Ghosthack — NI Massive presets** (Bassline · Bass · Deep Sci-Fi Pads) · about 26 · free, no email · dark bass and sci-fi pads · matches the lean directly · ghosthack.de/free_sample_packs/ni-massive-presets
**4 · Nyonyxx — Big 50** · 59 · free · futurestep and dubstep leads and basses · referenced across several independent lists
**5 · Virtual Riot bank** (via District FLP's mirror on ToneDen) · 64 (35 bass · 16 synth · 5 FX · 5 lead · 3 arp) · free · signature growls · fan mirror, not official: scan the zip first
**6 · ADSR — MassiveSynth tutorial presets** · 10 to 15 · ADSR account · arps, chord stabs, bounce bass · trusted educational vendor
**7 · Mad Massive Library** · 500+ · Mediafire, no email · bulk grab-bag, unverified quality
**8 · Multiplier's Collection** · 1,400 · Mediafire, no email · the largest free bank; same caveat
**Skipped:** five-preset demo teasers (Tunecraft / ADSR paid-pack demos) · Knife Party's six · Function Loops and Black Octopus have no standalone free Massive pack.
